description: Staged dialogue control for coaching-conversation practice (powerful questions, inquiry over advice, GROW-ish structure, listening). Stages have entry/exit conditions; the coach module controls transitions; the persona module (the coachee) only generates turns within the active stage. Adapted from the Phase 3 sparring 5-stage core. Grounding (VERIFIED): the sparring core's evidence base applies here — EasyMED 2025 (separated persona/coach modules, psychological safety), AgentForge 2026 (visible coordination demands drive learning). Adaptation decisions below are RECONSTRUCTED.

kept: 5-stage core ids (engage/explore/challenge/consolidate/close) for interface compatibility with the sparring core
changed: REMAPped stage semantics onto GROW-ish structure: engage ~ Goal-orientation, explore ~ Reality, challenge ~ Options (inquiry-tension), consolidate ~ Will / next steps, close ~ debrief. GROW is an established coaching frame; mapping it onto the core is a RECONSTRUCTED design decision, not doctrine

REDEFINED challenge stage: in coaching practice the pressure is the coachee's advice-seeking and deflection ('just tell me what to do'), not argumentative pushback; the user's job is to hold inquiry (RECONSTRUCTED from inquiry-over-advice as the domain's core target)

ADDED advice_suppression_active guard: the coach module monitors the USER's turns for advice-verbs during challenge and nudges back to inquiry; the persona may request advice, the user must not supply it (RECONSTRUCTED; grounded in the MI package's evocation-not-accusation and the coaching inquiry rubric)
